# Computer Science > Computation and Language

[Submitted on 31 Aug 2026]

# Title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding

Authors: Gengxu Li , Yuan Wu , Yi Chang

View a PDF of the paper titled OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding, by Gengxu Li and 2 other authors

View PDF HTML (experimental)

> Abstract: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(35\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at this https URL .

summaryZh: OCR-MetaReasoning是一个专门评估多模态大模型（MLLM）在富文本图像理解中元推理能力的基准测试。该基准将推理过程拆解为演绎、归纳和溯因三种类型，并引入了推理过程合规性评分（RPCS）和元推理宏观评分（MRMS），旨在区分模型最终答案的正确性与推理过程的逻辑合规性。实验表明，当前主流模型在处理布局敏感的推理任务时仍存在显著不足，该基准为评估模型视觉推理能力提供了更细粒度的度量标准。

glossary.explanationZh: 多模态大语言模型，具备处理文本与图像等多种模态数据的能力。
光学字符识别，用于从图像中提取文本信息。
元推理，指对推理过程本身的思考与评估能力。
推理过程合规性评分，衡量模型推理步骤是否符合逻辑规范。
元推理宏观评分，综合评估模型在不同推理任务上的表现。
